method: Single photograph interpreted with approximately uniform facade-plane scale. No camera calibration or survey. Pixel annotations are rounded visual estimates. Window UV mappings are local to each physical glass rectangle.
image_uv_conversion: u=x/1884; v=1-y/1344. This normalized annotation coordinate system is deliberately independent of the original JPEG pixel dimensions.
limits: Photo shading and reflections are baked into the sampled colour. This is not calibrated base colour.
Known occluding street lights and cabinets are excluded conservatively; masked areas retain ordinary geometric material.
Photographic texture omitted from attic, cornices, window frames, columns, roof, side and rear.
Glass uses six specific photographed window interiors, while physical mullions remain separate 3-D geometry.
Approximate geometric proportions and unseen parts remain interpretive; not a measured reconstruction.
